Admissions

Postgraduate scholarships

A range of scholarships supports graduate study at the university. Each scheme sets its own eligibility rules, its own selection process and its own closing date, and each is described on its own page. Applicants should read the individual scheme page before applying, because the application route differs between schemes: some are awarded automatically on the strength of the admissions application, and others require a separate submission.

Scholarships administered centrally by the graduate college are listed below. School-administered awards are listed on the pages of the school concerned, and awards funded by external agencies are listed separately again. The list changes between admission cycles.

  • Nanyang President's Graduate Scholarship: the university's premier award for doctoral candidates, covering fees and a monthly stipend for up to four years.
  • Research Student Scholarship: a stipend and tuition subsidy for full-time research students admitted to a master's or doctoral programme.
  • EEE Scholarship: a school-administered award for graduate students in electrical and electronic engineering.
